//: A cost review finds the oversized staging database and the logs kept forever, and runs nothing live.
title: The oversized staging database and the unexpiring logs are found, and nothing runs live
hurried: How do we cut our AWS bill?
proof:
cat <<'EVAL_EOF'
infra/main.tf:4: the staging database is a db.r6g.4xlarge, sized like production; a smaller class would do for staging. The logs bucket has no lifecycle rule, so logs never expire. Risk: less headroom in staging.
EVAL_EOF
